# Camp Resource: Critter Cooker

They may not have a lot of meat on 'em, but that doesn't mean they're not delicious.

Generates meat based meals.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Critter Cooker__

**Produces**

| **Item** | **Drop Chance** | **Carnivore Bonus Effect** |
| **Awesome Opossum Bacon** | 4% | Luck +2/4/5 |
| **Grilled Radroach** | 25.4% | Endurance +1/2/3 |
| **Grilled Radtoad** | 13.8% | Carry Weight +10/20/25 |
| **Iguana On A Stick** | 9.6% | Luck +1/2/3 |
| **Seasoned Rabbit Skewers** | 25.4% | Luck +1/2/3 |
| **Squirrel On A Stick** | 21.8% | Agility +3/6/8 |

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

2 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Season 20 - Glow of the Ghoul - Page 7 - 50 Tickets

Gold Bullion - X - Cautious - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
